item: Row 367: the Home tab follows a language switch
key_paths: src/static/app-home.js; src/static/app-boot.js; configs/i18n_frozen_renderers.txt; tests/home_live_node_test.js; tests/test_home_live.py; tests/feed_restart_node_test.js; tests/test_weather_context_r683.py
summary: Thirteen app-home.js renderers leave the frozen list. The Loading lines of Feed, Latest, Most recent, a weather check and the link preview are held until what they wait for lands; the link preview's lines, the trending strip (kept as drawn under another language, M8's guard, until the switch's re-read lands), a late Home subtab's label and the dismiss-reason form (reasons, placeholder, button; typed text kept) are held; the alert strip and the Leads carousel are drawn again from what they hold (repaintHomeAlerts, repaintLeadsCarousel; position and pause kept; never a fetch). The weather question's dates line moved to its own helper, same words. No new strings.
